parent_objective: implement and smoke-test family-specific no-policy source repair profiles
blocked_by: M1319 admits source_repair_v1 no-policy repair smoke
supersedes: corpus export from the M1317 partial active-family subset

public_gates: M1320 must not use private holdout
M1320 must preserve actor input contract
M1320 must keep strict source acceptance thresholds
M1320 must export active and inactive family diagnostics

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: tests whether family-specific no-policy repair profiles activate inactive or undercovered source families
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: source-repair infrastructure only; no promotion, private-holdout, PPO, closed-loop, paper-level, high-fidelity, or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if source thresholds must be relaxed
stop if repair requires actor input expansion
stop if no inactive or undercovered family improves
stop if runtime requires splitting by family
fallback_plan: if repair succeeds, route to updated source corpus export design
if repair is partial, route to source repair result audit
if families remain action-equivalent, route to simulator/source-search extension design
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1319 design admits one no-policy source repair smoke

admission_evidence: M1317 leaves global friction, steering actuator, and load/CG inactive
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1320 is no-policy source repair and does not test closed-loop history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: generate richer source rows for later command-response history materialization
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If repaired families remain action-equivalent, export blockers rather than accepting weak rows.
allowed_claims: no strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, high-fidelity validation, real-vehicle, paper-result, or closed-loop driver claim

hypothesis: Family-specific source_repair_v1 profiles can activate at least one previously inactive or undercovered family without actor-input expansion or source-threshold relaxation.
success_criteria: accepted_separable_pairs >= 160 or explicit family blockers are reported
accepted_fault_family_pairs >= 6 or explicit family blockers are reported
at least one previously inactive family becomes active or all inactive families are classified as simulator/search-blocked
halfshaft accepted rows > 4 or halfshaft undercoverage blocker is reported
strict source acceptance thresholds are preserved
no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs
failure_criteria: training, PPO, private holdout, promotion, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs

commands.name: focused_tests
commands.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest -q tests/test_four_wheel_fault_source_shape.py tests/test_four_wheel_dynamics.py

commands.name: repair_smoke
commands.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m autodrift.four_wheel_fault_source_shape --fault-profile source_repair_v1 --scenario-profile source_repair_v1 --action-profile source_repair_v1 --run-dir runs/m1320_inactive_source_family_repair_smoke

decision_rule: M1320 passes as infrastructure if it runs a no-policy repair smoke with strict source thresholds, exported inactive-family diagnostics, and no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout use, threshold relaxation, hidden inactive-family handling, or actor-input expansion.
